parameters: \n<Capt. Valiente> Here we are! at the frontline!
\n<Capt. Valiente> I want everybody to give it their all,
defend this position and stay headfast!
\n<Capt. Valiente> The Japs will be coming anytime soon!
\n<Capt. Valiente> So get to your positions! and long live
\n<Carlos> Now that we're actually here it
\n<Pvt. Alvarez> Do you think we'll live through this..?
\n<Pvt. Alvarez> I think it's E compamy...
\n<Pvt. Alvarez> Was that the first wave?
\n<Capt. Valiente> Everybody get down and brace!
\n<Carlos> Was that the last of them?
\n<Capt. Valiente> That was just a prodding maneuver...!
\n<Capt. Valiente> I want all the Injured to be brought back to the
aid station! all of those still able to fight reinforce the holes!
\n<Capt. Valiente> You two stay there, Defend this position!
\n<Pvt. Alvarez> How...much ammo do you have left...?
\n<Pvt. Alvarez> How are we still alive...?
\n<Carlos> I'll go check the back line for some...
\n<Carlos> Come on...is there any ammunition here?
\n<Carlos> Come on...There's got to be some...
\n<Carlos> I Need to get back to the Line!
\n<Pvt. Alvarez> They got our left flank...
